breakdown.description: It asks for the subsurface carbon content to reach 1.10 wt% C even though the surface is held at only 0.90 wt% C. A concentration inside the solid cannot exceed the imposed constant surface concentration in this setup.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the core inconsistency. The ground truth corrects the impossible desired carbon concentration (1.10 wt%) to a physically plausible value (0.60 wt%). The agent, however, kept the user's incorrect value of 1.10 wt% and merely added a note at the end explaining that it was physically impossible. This does not resolve the issue as required; it repeats the user's error instead of fixing it.
